title: Every worker of a headless runner is refused its first write: the guard's project is the runner's worktree and the worker's isolation worktree is a sibling under the clone's .claude/worktrees
goal: headless_guard allows a write inside a worker's isolation worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-* of the same clone as the runner's project (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is .claude/worktrees/runner-SP-*), and still denies any path outside the clone and outside that worktrees directory; a planted test covers the sibling, a path outside the clone, a path in another clone's worktrees, and a .. escape; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3), Stage 1 repeated in a real clone: exit 0, cause blocked, nothing landed, and it blocks every item of every sprint, so no unattended run can land work until it is fixed

run: import os,sys; os.environ['KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER']='1'; os.environ['CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR']='/tmp/clone-x/.claude/worktrees/runner-SP-xxxxxxxx'; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kb_hook; r=kb_hook.headless_guard({'tool_name':'Write','tool_input':{'file_path':'/tmp/clone-x/.claude/worktrees/agent-a1/kb/_self/reports/t.md','content':'x'}}); sys.exit(0 if r is None else 1)
